title: Criteria/matrix mismatch
text: Criteria/matrix mismatch: the normative matrix says an unreadable category list “never leaves the head without a result,” but AC2 explicitly preserves supersede behavior, under which a pass superseded before publication produces no review. A pass can read the malformed list and then be superseded, so these rules require conflicting outcomes. State instead that list failure does not itself suppress publication and remains subject to AC2.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 958fde7, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
